formulas.ascii: Core test, not the labelling: |N(i)| = number of valid points j (point i itself included) with dx^2 + dy^2 <= epsilon^2 in f32; point i is core when |N(i)| >= minimumPoints. Clusters are the connected components of core points under that relation, found by lock-free union-find; a border point (valid, not core, with a core neighbour) joins the adjacent cluster with the smallest root, every other point is noise (0xffffffff). Compact cluster ids follow the smallest core row, so labels are canonical.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
offsets[i] = sum(flags[0..i-1]) mod 2^32; count = offsets[n-1]+flags[n-1] mod 2^32, or 0 when empty. Flags are raw uint32 values.
